_source: Entered directly through the Report Checklist page's Staff & Drs Leave weekly grid, saved straight from the website — no screenshot or PDF for this date. BACKFILLED 2026-11-24: the website always saves the leave grid under whichever date is "today" in the browser, with no way to pick a different date; this week's grid was actually saved on Tuesday 24 Nov (see assets/data/reports/2026-11-24/leave.json), but the work week itself starts Monday 23 Nov, and Call Logs always run a day behind — so the next report to be generated would be dated 2026-11-23 and would otherwise find no leave.json here at all (the one under 2026-11-24 isn't visible to carry-forward, since it isn't "before" this date). Copied here unchanged except reportDate/reportTitle so Monday's own report finds its week's data directly.
